messages:
nina: Heads-up: nightly invoice-sync produced duplicate line items in NetSuite for ~23 invoices. Not double-charges, but accounting view is wrong.

nina: Short log:
```
WARNING invoice_sync: duplicate line detected for invoice inv_05Aabc, item_code=usage_monthly, count_in_ns=2
```

nina: The common factor is we processed `invoice.updated` webhooks that include a full line_item array and our importer currently upserts line_items by creating new records without checking external_id. If webhook replay + sync job both run we end up with dup lines.

raj: Were customers charged twice?

evan: No charges duplicated on Stripe. NetSuite only had doubled line rows (affects revenue recognition and AR aging).

ops-jen: Can we mitigate quickly? Disable the scheduled sync job and pause webhook replays?

nina: I paused scheduled nightly import. Webhook consumer still running.

raj: Short-term fix: add idempotency check in importer: query NetSuite for existing line with external_ref=line_item.id before create. Long-term: switch to a single-authoritative flow: webhooks mutate a minimal state and full sync is a reconcile that uses external_ref to replace rather than append.

evan: Also add a dedupe backfill: for invoices in date range 2026-03-20..2026-03-23, collapse duplicate lines and export `finance_dup_line_report.csv` to s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/ for finance review.

billing-bot: Created FIN-4999: "Invoice importer: dedupe line items + idempotency for webhook/sync" assigned to @raj, priority P2, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4999

raj: Plan: (1) quick guard in importer to skip create if external_ref exists (2) add unit/integration test for webhook replay + scheduled job scenario (3) run backfill in dry-run to generate CSV for finance, then apply changes. ETA: 6 hours.

evan: Please include original webhook event bodies into audit s3 key `s3://redwood-billing/audit/webhooks/{event_id}.json` with restricted ACL and 60d lifecycle. Finance wants the CSV before we mutate NS.

nina: Backfill status: identified 23 affected invoices, preparing dry-run; will post CSV to FIN-4999 when ready.

ops-jen: SRE note: replay behavior stems from lambda ack timing. Consider making webhook consumer ack only after successful enqueue to the sync queue and durable write.

raj: Good call. Will update consumer to ack after db write and integrate a short redis dedupe cache for event.id for 1h.

evan: Thanks team. Finance, expect the reconciliation CSV and proposed remediation steps in FIN-4999. :thumbsup:
